name: God Given Talents 2
overview: Scripture reveals that God endows His people with diverse talents and gifts according to His grace and wisdom, as seen in Exodus 35:31 and Romans 12:6. These abilities are entrusted to believers to be stewarded faithfully, exemplified in the parable of the talents in Matthew 25:14-15, where servants receive resources proportional to their capacity. Abiding in Christ is essential for fruitful use of these gifts, since apart from Him we can do nothing (John 15:5). The renewing of the mind enables believers to discern and fulfill God's perfect will in exercising their God-given talents (Romans 12:2).
